what: Vulcan Materials is the largest supplier of construction aggregates in the United States: crushed stone, sand and gravel, plus asphalt mix and ready-mixed concrete made from them.
customers: State highway departments, infrastructure and commercial contractors, data centre builders and housebuilders.
moat: Quarry positions in the fastest-growing US states, where new permits are nearly impossible to obtain and haulage costs protect each site's local market.
risks: Residential construction is weak while mortgage rates are high
Debt of about $5 billion against almost no cash
Infrastructure volumes depend on state and federal budgets
Energy and diesel costs affect production and haulage
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year with a 20% operating margin
Data centre construction consumes large volumes of aggregates
Pricing has risen ahead of costs for several years
watch: Aggregates price per tonne and shipment volumes.
